يعلولوا (form XII)
# يَعْلَوْلُوا (yaʕlawlū) /jaʕ.law.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# يُعْلَوْلَوْا (yuʕlawlaw) /juʕ.law.law/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
